metadata.description: Marketplace for spec-flow — a spec-driven workflow plugin for Claude Code.

plugins.name: sf
plugins.description: Turn a messy SRS - or just an idea - into a reviewed Solution Design, then traceable, adaptive implementation. Spec-driven with change-driven resync/change/bug loops + branch-per-SD; bundles manual-test + commit; keyless via Task Master, no lock-in.

_notes.standalone: spec-flow is self-contained: one `/plugin install sf` is all a team member needs. The manual-test and commit skills ship INSIDE this plugin (skills/manual-test, skills/commit). Branch policy (1 SD = 1 branch, no commit on base) is config-driven via .spec-flow/config.json → branching. The task engine is bundled and zero-network (bin/mcp-server.js, declared in .mcp.json) — no external package fetch, no manual install.
_notes.member-prereqs: node >= 18 and the Claude Code CLI. No API key needed by default — /sf:init sets the task engine to the keyless `claude-code` provider (uses your Claude Code session). An ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / PERPLEXITY_API_KEY is optional, only if a member prefers their own provider.
